description: Frontend - Complete Next.js application with all pages, components, and features for the Craq platform. Includes auth pages, issues feed, solutions, user profiles, tools directory, search, AI features, dark/light mode, and responsive design.
steps: Initialize /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/ as a Next.js 14 project with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, App Router. Dependencies: next, react, react-dom, tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, lucide-react, zustand (state), axios, date-fns, zod, react-hook-form, @hookform/resolvers, next-themes (dark mode), react-hot-toast, react-markdown.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/tailwind.config.ts with custom theme colors for Craq brand (professional blues, purples for business), dark mode class strategy.

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/app/layout.tsx - Root layout with ThemeProvider (dark/light mode), global styles, Inter font, metadata with 'Craq - Crack any business problem' tagline.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/lib/api.ts - Axios instance configured with base URL, JWT interceptor for auth headers, response error handling.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/stores/authStore.ts - Zustand store for auth state: user, token, login(), logout(), register(), checkAuth().
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/stores/themeStore.ts - Theme state management for dark/light mode toggle.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/types/ - TypeScript interfaces matching backend types: User, Issue, Solution, Comment, Vote, Tool, Tag.

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/components/layout/Header.tsx - Navigation header with logo 'Craq', tagline, nav links (Feed, Tools, Search), user menu, dark/light toggle, auth buttons. Responsive hamburger menu for mobile.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.tsx - Simple footer with links and copyright.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx - Left sidebar with category filters, industry filters, stage filters for issues feed.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/app/page.tsx - Landing/home page with hero section explaining Craq, call to action, featured issues, stats.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/app/auth/login/page.tsx - Login page with email/password form, Google OAuth button, link to register.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/app/auth/register/page.tsx - Registration page with name, email, password, role selection (entrepreneur/solver/both), industry, stage.

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/app/issues/page.tsx - Issues feed page with infinite scroll, filter sidebar, sort options (trending, recent, unsolved), issue cards showing title, preview, tags, votes, solution count, status badge.

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/app/issues/new/page.tsx - Create new issue page with rich form: title, description (markdown), image upload, category selector, industry, stage, type, tags. AI-powered: auto-categorize on blur, show similar solved issues as suggestions.

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/app/issues/[id]/page.tsx - Issue detail page showing full issue, solutions list sorted by votes with accepted solution highlighted at top, comment threads on issue and solutions, vote buttons, accept solution button (for issue author), AI summarize thread button.

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/components/issues/IssueCard.tsx - Card component for issue list: title, preview text, author avatar+name, tags, vote count, solution count, status badge, time ago.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/components/issues/IssueFilters.tsx - Filter panel: category, industry, stage, type, status (open/solved), sort by.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/components/solutions/SolutionCard.tsx - Solution display with content, author, votes, accepted badge, comments.

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/components/solutions/SolutionForm.tsx - Form to post a solution with text editor, image upload. AI 'Generate Draft' button that creates an editable solution suggestion.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/components/common/VoteButtons.tsx - Upvote/downvote component with count, active state indication.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/components/common/CommentThread.tsx - Threaded comments component with reply, edit, delete.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/components/common/ImageUpload.tsx - Drag-and-drop image upload component with preview.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/components/common/TagBadge.tsx - Tag display component with color coding by type.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/components/common/StatusBadge.tsx - Open/Solved status badge.

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/app/profile/[id]/page.tsx - User profile page showing: avatar, name, bio, industry, stage, skills, reputation score, joined date, activity tabs (issues posted, solutions given, accepted solutions).
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/app/profile/edit/page.tsx - Edit profile page with all profile fields.

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/app/tools/page.tsx - Tools directory page with grid/list view, category filter, search, tool cards showing name, description, rating, review count, linked problem types.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/app/tools/[id]/page.tsx - Tool detail page with description, user reviews, linked issues, add review form.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/app/search/page.tsx - Search page with query input, type tabs (issues, solutions, users, tools), filters, results display.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/components/ai/AISuggestions.tsx - Component showing AI-suggested similar issues when composing a new issue.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/components/ai/AISolutionDraft.tsx - Component for AI-generated solution drafts that users can edit before posting.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/components/ai/AIThreadSummary.tsx - Component showing AI-summarized actionable steps from a thread.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/lib/websocket.ts - WebSocket client for real-time notifications.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/components/notifications/NotificationBell.tsx - Notification bell in header with dropdown showing recent notifications.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/src/middleware.ts - Next.js middleware for protected routes (redirect to login if not authenticated).
Add responsive design throughout - all components should work on mobile (320px+) and desktop.
Ensure dark/light mode works across all components using Tailwind dark: classes.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/jest.config.ts and a basic test for the home page component.
Verify: npm run build compiles the Next.js app successfully.
acceptance_criteria: All pages are accessible: home, login, register, issues feed, issue detail, new issue, profile, tools, search
Dark/light mode toggle works across all components
Responsive design works on mobile and desktop viewports
Auth flow handles login, register, and protected routes
Issue creation form includes AI-powered auto-categorization and similar issue suggestions
Solutions support AI draft generation that is user-editable
Vote buttons work for issues and solutions
WebSocket client connects for real-time notifications
Tools directory shows tools with reviews
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend && npm install && npm run build
